label: Macrophage Immune-Competent Colon Assembloids for Functional Interrogation of Neuroinflammation-Induced Colonic Dysmotility.
summary: Background and Aims: Functional gastrointestinal disorders affect ∼40% of the global population and are frequently characterized by colonic dysmotility. Symptomatic manifestations of colonic dysmotility significantly reduce quality of life in inflammatory bowel disease, diabetes, and Gulf War Illness.
